thag1.27:1.1: The grasses mentioned are dabba, kusa, poṭakila (kans grass, wild sugarcane), usīra (vetiver), muñja (sugarcane bamboo grass), and pabbaja (here unlikely to be Eleusine indica per usual identification, because it is too short. Perhaps meadow foxtail (Alopecurus pratensis). Thag 3.5 gives a little more context.
